why: All three checks positively confirm the finding. (1) DOC: the quoted sentence exists VERBATIM at interactive-mode.md:359, under the heading '## Side questions with /btw' (line 357). Read whole: nothing in the line or its section reverses the conclusion; the section goes on to specify the ephemeral overlay, no-tool-access, single-response and fork-with-'f' behaviours. '/recap' is likewise real, at line 402: 'Run `/recap` to generate a summary on demand.' The four settings keys are all real doc references: respondToBashCommands (line 321), emojiCompletionEnabled (line 355), editorMode + vimInsertModeRemaps (lines 140, 146-147), and '!' shell mode (lines 88, 300-321). (2) CITED FILE: apps/electron/src/renderer/components/ui/slash-command-menu.tsx:17 says exactly what was claimed - `export type SlashCommandId = PermissionMode | CustomSlashCommandId | 'agents' | 'automations' | 'compact' | 'context' | 'create-skill' | 'create-plugin' | 'export' | 'init' | 'memory' | 'model' | 'clear' | 'help' | 'subtask' | 'usage'` - neither 'btw' nor 'recap'. This union is the single definition of the built-in set; its only consumers are the same file, the playground registry and App.tsx/ChatDisplay.tsx pass-through, so there is no second registry adding them. (3) CONSEQUENCE, verified separately from the identifiers: grep -ain over the 3574 tracked source files returns ZERO for sideQuestion, sessionRecap, respondToBashCommands, emojiCompletionEnabled, vimInsertModeRemaps and editorMode; also zero for vim, emoji, shellMode/bashMode and any startsWith('!') composer branch. I then looked for the two known false-positive shapes and found neither: no upstream handler (no quickQuestion/ephemeralQuestion/noHistory path, no sessionSummary/generateSummary/autoTitle, no recap-on-resume - the only 'recap' hits are the substring inside acquireCapabilityTurn), and no sibling subsystem owning the behaviour under another name (no terminal panel: no xterm/node-pty anywhere, the sole shell hit is apps/electron/src/main/shell-env.ts, which is env resolution). NOT one of the nine owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (those are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, and listSessionSummaries/listSessions). NOT one of the fork's stated product differences either - it is unrelated to the dropped Claude/ChatGPT subscription flows, to the corporate-gateway targeting, and to the NESSY_/@nessy-agent/ renaming. The repo's own coverage map already grades this page 2026-07-31-claude-coverage-map.md:112 as partial (yellow), which is consistent with a real remaining gap rather than a closed one.
correctedState: The finding stands, with three corrections to its wording and scope. (a) The claimed evidence overstates the grep: run verbatim, `grep -rain "..." packages apps` does NOT return nothing - it returns ~66KB of hits from node_modules and from apps/electron/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js, an UNTRACKED local build artifact whose highlight.js ARMA-script keyword blob contains the substring editorMode. The absence claim is only true when scoped to tracked source; scoped that way it holds exactly (zero hits across 3574 tracked .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.json files, checked with -a). (b) 'the settings keys that govern them' conflates two unrelated groups. respondToBashCommands, emojiCompletionEnabled, editorMode and vimInsertModeRemaps govern shell mode, emoji completion and vim mode - they do not govern /btw or /recap. Per the page, /btw has no settings key at all, and automatic recap is toggled through `/config` and 'Session recap' (line 402), not through settings.json. (c) The gap is not uniform in kind. /btw, /recap and emoji shortcode completion are UI-agnostic conversation/input features and are unambiguous divergences. editorMode/vimInsertModeRemaps and the '!' shell prefix are terminal-input affordances of a TUI, and this fork has no TUI to host them: the only surfaces are the Electron React composer and apps/cli, which is non-interactive by design (apps/cli/src/index.ts:616 - 'run is our non-interactive -p mode'; the sole stdin path at readPrompt(), index.ts:423-438, reads piped input, and there is no readline or keypress loop). That does not make them non-gaps, but implementing them would mean building a composer-side editor mode rather than honouring a readline setting, so they should be tracked as a separate, differently-shaped item from /btw and /recap.
